comment: Independent bones.c witness for engrave.c save_engravings() and rest_engravings() on a bones level. A debug dwarven Valkyrie goes to a new level 3, writes 'Ingrid fell here' in the dust, steps west, is killed by a minotaur there, and saves bones. A second game on another seed and clock goes to level 3, loads the bones (restore.c getlev() reads the engravings after the object chains), quaffs a wished blessed potion of object detection, and asks to teleport onto the engraved square. The minotaur stands there, so safe_teleds() places the hero elsewhere, and the minotaur's next move rubs out part of the engraving (engrave.c wipe_engr_at() -> wipeout_text()). The seeds, clocks and inputs were chosen for this path.
